Press & Coverage
Salesforce launches enterprise vibe-coding product, Agentforce Vibes

Salesforce has introduced Agentforce Vibes, a new AI-powered "vibe-coding" tool for enterprise developers. It includes an autonomous agent called Vibe Codey that integrates with a company's existing Salesforce org, re-uses code and coding standards, and helps move from idea to app with built-in observability, security and governance.

Product · Oct 29, 2025
Samsung Electronics to adopt AI coding assistant to boost developer productivity

Samsung Electronics will beta-test the open-source AI coding assistant Cline in its Device eXperience (DX) division (mobile, TV, home appliances) and plans full rollout soon. The goal: raise developer productivity and build out an internal AI productivity innovation group.

Research · Sep 12, 2025
Getting Started: Vibe Coding Locally with AMD Ryzen AI and Radeon Graphics Cards

AMD explores the shift toward "vibe-coding" — where developers prompt in natural language and AI writes code — and presents a guide to doing it locally on Ryzen AI + Radeon hardware. Running on-device avoids cloud costs and keeps data/private code internal. The article also highlights Cline as a prominent open-source coding agent for this workflow.

Research · Aug 29, 2025
The Prompt: The AI coding startup sitting out the margins game

In the latest edition of Forbes' "The Prompt", the article explores how an AI-coding startup is avoiding the classic margin squeeze in this space by letting developers pay model providers directly rather than taking the margin themselves. The piece offers a thoughtful view on business models in the AI coding assistant market.

Product · Oct 29, 2025
Cline: The Open Source Code Agent

A deep dive on Cline from Latent.Space discusses how the open-source VS Code extension is carving out a space in the AI-coding agent ecosystem. It covers Cline's "plan + act" paradigm, agent workflows, modular design (MCPs), and enterprise considerations such as transparency and control.

Product · Oct 29, 2025
